metadata.title: GAIA-FP: Gaia DR3 development and reproducibility audit supplement (2 November 2026)
metadata.description: Pre-DR4 development and reproducibility supplement for GAIA-FP. Includes selected Gaia DR3 derivative tables, a 95-object label/membership crosswalk, selection diagnostics, a positive-unlabelled SB2 ranking audit, APOGEE per-object summary outputs, source scripts, and round-by-round audit reports. The SB2 ranking result is based on 16 known positive controls and 2,086 unlabelled candidates; it is not a specificity or precision estimate. Real APOGEE variability is available for a limited 46-object cohort, but the raw 351 accepted visit timestamp rows are not present in this deposit. Exact observed-cadence injection-recovery, GALAH/LAMOST per-epoch RV analyses, full upstream H10 source reconstruction, and Gaia DR4 evaluation remain not conducted because required inputs are not present or DR4 is not yet released.
